name: durable-core
about: durable-bench's workload (a scripted model calls a lookup tool; ten measured eight-tool turns on a seeded store) run by durable/interop/bench.mjs on Node: on pi-durable, pi-ai and chord from the Pi sources at durable/contract/PIN main (the conformance gate's reference), and on PiG's Durable core built with TinyGo through durable/core/host/cf's pi-durable-compatible facade on node:sqlite (both programs built by durable/core/host/cf/bench/build.mjs); and the same workload on the core built natively (durable/core/sqlhost/cmd/bench seed and sample, the Go port of bench.mjs's scripted model). Every target seeds its own store from zero and must reproduce durable-bench's history fingerprint and the same measured transcript.
